gloss_en: finding God (Hashem, blessed be He) equally in both good fortune (b'tivu) and adversity (b'aku) — the undivided perception of the Divine in all one's experiences, expressed by 'In the Lord I praise the word, in God I praise the word' (Ps. 56:11), which is the goal attained through Torah and the tzaddikim who are called peace (LM I:33)
canonical_he: ימצא השם יתברך בין בטיבו בין בעקו
